title: One Sunny Day
description: Students of the Darul Uloom Riyaz-Us-Saliheen school enjoy their break on a sunny afternoon in Jammu and Kashmir, India, in this image from the 2026 Giga Photo Award competition. Due to years of conflict and heavy military control in Kashmir—an ongoing dispute over territory between India, Pakistan, and China—children are forced to study in difficult and sometimes dangerous conditions. Islamic schools in the region, called madrassas, are not only meant for educational purposes, but they also offer food, shelter, and a means of routine and stability for students.
translated_description: 在印度查谟和克什米尔地区一个阳光明媚的午后，Darul Uloom Riyaz-Us-Saliheen学校的学生们正在享受课间休息。这张照片来自2026年Giga摄影奖大赛。由于克什米尔地区多年冲突及印度、巴基斯坦和中国之间持续的领土争端，该地军事管控严密，孩子们不得不在艰难甚至有时危险的环境中学习。当地被称为"madrassas"的伊斯兰学校不仅承担教育职能，还为学生提供食物、住所，并帮助他们建立规律的生活秩序与稳定感。
